  SPECIAL MEETING

  NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL (Government Code
  Section 54956)

  TO THE MEMBERS OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL

NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Mayor that a special meeting of the City Council will be held on
Wednesday, July 14, 2021, at 9:00 A.M., in the Jr. Executive Conference Room, located on the 9th
Floor at One Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood, California (Government Code Section 54956).

*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency
and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive
Order N-29-20 (https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-EO.pdf).

Please note that members of the public will be allowed to observe and/or address the City Council at
 and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive
Order N-29-20 (https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-EO.pdf).

Please note that members of the public will be allowed to observe and/or address the City Council at
the Special Meeting of July 14, 2021, at 9:00 A.M. for open session as follows:

  1. Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments
  electronically for consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor
  Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority
  (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City Clerk/Secretary at
  athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at aallen@cityofinglewood.org .
  To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of
  the agenda, please submit comments prior to 7:00 A.M. the day of the meeting, and in
  the body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter.
  Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments
  received after 7:00 A.M. and prior to the close of the public hearings, will be made part
  of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310-
  412-5280 with any questions.

  2. By Telephone-Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments: Members of
  the public can participate in the meeting by telephone to listen and make comments
  noting the following:

  l  If you are dialing in from a cell phone, please call from an area with good reception. Calls
  from landline phones are highly recommended.
  l  If you are watching the meeting via Social Media or Channel 35 while also accessing the
  phone line, it is requested that you mute the sound of your video feed as it is delayed from
  the phone transmission. Additionally, when you are making public comments on the
  phone line, you will be inaudible due to feedback.
  l  Dial-In: 1-669-900-6833; Meeting ID: 893 0593 2377 (Access Code: 756199#)

  3. Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:

  l  On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your
  cable provider for details.

The above access options provide the public with the opportunity to both observe and listen to the
meeting; however, members of the public who wish to orally address the Legislative Body must use
the public access options 1 and 2 noted above.

ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the
Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and regulations
adopted in implementation thereof. Any person who requires a disability-related modification or
accommodation, or translation services in order to observe and/or offer public comment may request
such reasonable modification, accommodation, or service by contacting the Office of the City Clerk
by telephone at 310-412-5280, FAX at 310-412-5533, One Manchester Boulevard, First Floor,
Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301 or via email to athompson@cityofinglewood.org and
aallen@cityofinglewood.org no later than 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting.

Inglewood, California
  July 14, 2021

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on
  Wednesday, July 14, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Tem Morales
  called the City Council into session at the hour of 9:01 a.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, and Mayor Tem
  Morales,
  Absent:  Council Member Faulk, and Mayor Butts.
  City officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  PUBLIC COMMENTS. Mayor Pro Tem Morales inquired if there were any persons
  present who wished to address the City Council on this matter.

  There was no response.

178  PAYMENTS AUTHORIZED – COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES; RESOLUTION
  NO. 21-105 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2020-2021 BUDGET.
  Staff report dated July 14, 2021, was presented recommending authorization to pay
  invoices from the County of Los Angeles for Supplemental Law Enforcement Services
  provided to the City of Inglewood.

  It was moved by Council Member Dotson, and seconded by Council Member Padilla that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Authorize payment in the amount of $90,099; 2)
  Authorize payment in an estimated amount of $367,010 for services rendered that have
  not been invoiced by the County of Los Angeles; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 21-105
  entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR
  2021-2022 BUDGET

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, and Mayor Pro Tem Morales;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Faulk, and Mayor Butts.

178  AGREEMENT NO. 21-191 APPROVED – CITY OF HAWTHORNE;
  RESOLUTION NO. 21-106 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2020-
  2021 BUDGET.  Staff report dated July 14, 2021, was presented recommending
  approval of an agreement with the City of Hawthorne (with an option to extend two (2)
  additional years in one-year increments) authorizing the Chief of Police (or designee) to
  request supplemental law enforcement services for special events.

  It was moved by Council Member Dotson, and seconded by Council Member Padilla that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve Agreement No. 21-191 in an amount not to
  exceed $500,000; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 21-106 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOD, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2021-
  2022 BUDGET TO INCLUDE FUNDS IN THE AMOUNT OF $500,000

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
   Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, and Mayor Pro Tem Morales;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Faulk, and Mayor Butts.

178  AGREEMENT NO. 21-192 APPROVED – CALIFORNIA HIGHWAY PATROL
  (CHP). Staff report dated July 14, 2021, was presented recommending approval of
  agreements with the California Highway Patrol (CHP) authorizing the Chief of Police to
  request supplemental law enforcement services from the CHP for professional sporting
  and entertainment events.

  It was moved by Council Member Dotson, and seconded by Council Member Padilla that
  the City Council does hereby approved Agreement No. 21-192. The motion was carried
  by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, and Mayor Pro Tem Morales;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Faulk, and Mayor Butts.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Pro Tem Morales declared the
  meeting adjourned at the hour of 9:04 a.m.

  Approved this ________ day of ____________ 2021

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ____________________________
  Eloy Morales, Jr., Mayor Pro Tem
